sections.title: Combat policy fine-tune

summary.toddler: 25/25 solo get-up drops passed for each body; keep those policies frozen.
summary.child: Warm-start the weakest measured combat body from its own shipped actor.
summary.adult: 457 PPO updates, zero NaN-gradient updates. Not graduated: consecutive-episode and Unity/16-player gates remain mandatory.

sections.verdict: Three-way share rose 25.78% to 30.47% (+4.69 percentage points), jitter fell 3.51%. Three seeds do not establish significance (candidate share 95% half-width: 8.46 points). Auxiliary physics diagnostics contained NaNs; the environment resets nonfinite worlds. Learner tensors and gradients remained finite. Not promoted: see the duel stalling regression below. All shipped assets are unchanged.

sections.title: Preliminary duel regression: 64 rounds, one seed per case

summary.toddler: Compare the candidate and unchanged shipped Trump against the same frozen opponents.
summary.child: Candidate improved the measured three-way share and Grandpa duel, but strongly regressed into stalling against Kim.
summary.adult: Do not replace the game policy. Keep checkpoints for a later engagement-focused experiment and formal multi-seed gates.

sections.verdict: Rejected for promotion: the Kim duel's undecided rate rose from 4.69% to 89.06%, with zero candidate wins. These short single-seed checks are preliminary, not a Unity or full 16-player graduation gate.
